text: Wei Speedstout was a monk, who was master of ale and smithing.
Westfall Brigade Hunter is a human located in the Grizzly Hills. He kills the Mother of Bambina, and Bambina, turned vengeful, kills the hunter in turn.
Wesminstera is a green dragon in night elf visage located in Thaldraszus.
Wenigosa was a blue dragon who died from an unknown disease. Her name is on a Faded Gravestone at the Veiled Ossuary.

Whelptamer Akumi is a Blackrock clan orc found at the Valley of Ashes in the Burning Steppes. She is a hunter-type that uses either a bow or melee attacks. During combat she will summon multiple black whelplings to aid her.
Wetlands Surveyor is a dwarf located in Slabchisel's Survey in Wetlands.
Whuut is an orc located in Yelmak's Alchemy and Potions in the Drag in Orgrimmar.
Whrrrl is a lord of Skywall and is worshiped by the Galak in Thousand Needles. He is summoned by blowing a horn during Go Blow that Horn.
Whirling Kicks was a Windwalker monk honor talent, available at rank 6.
Whit Wantmal is a human located in Darkshire in Duskwood. His house is next to the gryphon master, Felicia Maline.

Wice was a black-skinned human from the who fought with her fellow soldiers in against the invading trolls. She survived the attack and returned to . Three days later, the trolls attacked it and she died during the battle.
Whompwhisker is a kobold warrior featured in the Kobolds & Catacombs expansion for Hearthstone. Whompwhisker is a kobold brawler.
Wild Gladiator's Desecration is the Warlords Season 2 death knight arena set.
Wilcott was a human who fought against the Syndicate in Arathi Highlands. He fell and his badge was taken by his killer, kept as a trophy until its retrieval by hired adventurers.
Wickerflame Burnbristle is a dwarven member of the Grimy Goons active in Gadgetzan in the Mean Streets of Gadgetzan expansion for Hearthstone.
Wild Gladiator's Battlegear is the Warlords Season 2 warrior arena set.
Wild Combatant's Desecration is the Warlords Season 2 death knight arena set.
Wild Combatant's Pursuit is the Warlords Season 2 hunter arena set.
Wild Combatant's Regalia is the Warlords Season 2 mage arena set.
Wild Combatant's Ironskin is the Warlords Season 2 monk arena set.
Wild Combatant's Pursuit is the Warlords Season 2 priest arena set.
Wild Combatant's Battlegear is the Warlords Season 2 warrior arena set.
Wicker-Bound Hunter is a wicker man located at Barrowknoll Cemetery in Drustvar.
Wicked Pete is a human located in the Ravens Flock Tavern in Boralus.
Wild Slashes is a Fury warrior artifact trait. It is linked to the Uncontrolled Rage and Thirst for Battle (artifact trait) traits.
Wild Gladiator's Sanctuary is the Warlords Season 2 hunter arena set.
Wild Gladiator's Sanctuary is the Warlords Season 2 mage arena set.
Wild Gladiator's Ironskin is the Warlords Season 2 monk arena set.
Wild Gladiator's Vindication is the Warlords Season 2 priest arena set.
Wild Instincts is a row 10 Beast Mastery hunter talent. It is an exclusive choice node with Bloody Frenzy.

Willem is a human soldier of the Stormwind Army. He reports to Marshal McBride. He first appeared as Deputy Willem overseeing the defense of Northshire Valley in Elwynn Forest. Upon the Cataclysm, he was promoted to Sergeant Willem. During the war in Draenor, he became Lieutenant Willem.
William MacGregor is a human bow vendor located at Sentinel Hill in Westfall. He was present during the Legion Invasions.
Wilda Bearmane is a Mag'har orc stable master located in Garadar in the Nagrand.
Wildervar Miner is a human located in Fort Wildervar in Howling Fjord.
Wilkinson is a worgen general goods vendor found near Raven Hill in Duskwood.

Willa Arnes is a human innkeeper located at Duskhaven in the worgen starting zone of Gilneas. After Duskhaven sinks in the Great Sea due to the Cataclysm, she moves with the other inhabitants to Stormglen Village. After that, she is never more seen in-game, so it is unknown if she joined the other Gilneas survivors in the evacuation or not.

Willam was a human entrusted with guarding the Dark Portal after its destruction. While it was an easy job, the cold from the valley was harsh and he did not like it at all. One night Willam and his comrade Randal were taken by surprise when the Dark Portal reopened and a dark shadow covered the area. Randal ordered Willam to sound the alarm to alert the other. While still in shock, he managed to warn everyone by sounding his horn. All guards guarding the Dark Portal were eventually killed when the Horde and death knight took it over.
Willard Blauvelt is an orc located at the Circle of Wills in Underbelly.
Wildcrafter Osme is a night elf herbalism trainer located at Lorlathil in Val'sharah.
Wilderness Expert is a Beast Mastery hunter artifact trait. It is linked to the Hunter's Advantage, Pack Leader (artifact trait), and Titan's Thunder traits.

Wildfire Infusion is a row 8 Survival hunter talent that transforms Wildfire Bomb into one of three alternate versions: Shrapnel Bomb, Pheromone Bomb, or Volatile Bomb. The bomb changes randomly after each cast, and the next bomb can be seen while Wildfire Bomb is recharging.
Willemm is a gnome character in Smokywood Pastures Presents: A Winter Veil Carol.

Windrunner's Overlook is a Silver Covenant High elf outpost in southeast Crystalsong Forest, on the opposite side of the Ruins of Shandaral from Sunreaver's Command in the Unbound Thicket. Silver Covenant Scouts are roaming in and around the outpost, protecting it. There are no quests involving the overlook. Following the war against the Jailer, the brothers Bronzebeard reported that Windrunner's Overlook is still the outpost of the Silver Covenant in Northrend, even after Dalaran moved years ago.
Wilmina Holbeck is a human Pilgrim's Bounty Vendor available during the Pilgrim's Bounty event. She is located outside the gates of Stormwind and is dressed in traditional female pilgrim attire.
Wind Rider Gorsch is an orc located at Valormok in Azshara. He went to help the orcs at Valormok after eating a nice seafood meal which he later regretted it.
Willy Maybe is a human located at the Aldur'thar: The Desolation Gate in Icecrown.

Willy Wilder is a level 90 rare human found in The Veiled Stair. He can often be found bidding on Blood-Soaked Invitation at the Black Market, and afterwards running down the Path of a Hundred Steps proclaiming his victory. Sadly the victim of his own bidding success, it's usually not long before Willy's joyful boasts draw the attentions of envious players.
Windcaller Korast is an orc located the Stones of Prophecy in .
Windreader Argoram is a Thunderlord orc located at the Magnarok in Frostfire Ridge.
Windcaller Voramus is a night elf located in the Molten Front.
Windcaller Nordrala is a night elf located in the Molten Front.
Wind Arrows is a Marksmanship hunter artifact trait. It is linked to the Windburst, Called Shot (artifact trait) and Quick Shot (hunter artifact trait) traits.
Windrunner's Guidance is a Marksmanship hunter artifact trait. It is linked to the Gust of Wind (hunter artifact trait) and Legacy of the Windrunners (artifact trait) traits.
Willow Tempest is a human stable master located at Arom's Stand in Drustvar. She is also present during Faction Assaults.
Windborne Blows is a Windwalker monk artifact trait. It is not linked to any other traits, and requires all other base traits to be acquired.

Wilmer was a member of the Desolate Council who participated in the Gathering in the Arathi Highlands. During the event, he reunited with the human Jago, who described Wilmer as "my Wilmer [...] the best man I ever knew and loved". After Sylvanas Windrunner recognized that members of the Desolate Council like Parqual Fintallas were trying to defect to the Alliance, she blew the horn of retreat commanding the Forsaken to return to her at Thoradin's Wall. However, after it was discovered that Calia Menethil had been attending, Sylvanas lashed out and ordered for the deaths of all Forsaken members on the field, regardless if they were trying to defect to the Alliance or return to her. Wilmer wa
Wilona Thorne is a human located at the in Crucible of the Damned in the Maw. She breathes her last, soon after the adventurer finds her.
Windrunner's Barrage is a row 10 Marksmanship hunter talent. It is an exclusive choice node with Readiness.
Wing Commander Jeztor is a Forsaken serving as senior wing commander of the Frostwolf clan in Alterac Valley. At the beginning of each match, she is held prisoner at the Stormpike lumber yard.
Wink Sprinklesprankle is a gnome general goods vendor located at Valgarde in the Howling Fjord.
Winifred Earlywind is a Wildhammer dwarf trade goods vendor located in Thundermar in the Twilight Highlands.
Winemaster Lydell is a night elf ghost located in Lost Orchard in Azsuna.
Winter Payne is a human located at Acherus: The Ebon Hold. He only appears after completing the Frost Wyrm class hall advancement.

Windrunning is a Marksmanship hunter artifact trait gained from Thas'dorah, Legacy of the Windrunners. This is a hidden trait that does not appear in either your spellbook or the artifact traits pane. It can stack up to 5, increasing movement speed by 25%.
Windspeaker Heldis is a human located in the Shrine of the Storm.

Winter's Envoy is a title obtained on a specific character by reaching Renown Level 40 in the Night Fae Covenant. The title is not account-wide. The character's name precedes the title in the following format: :, Winter's Envoy
Wisp Spirit is a night elf passive racial trait that increases speed after death.

Wise Scholar Lianji is a pandaren monk located at the Training Grounds of the Peak of Serenity in the Kun-Lai Summit. She is accompanied by two Avatars of Jade and observes Aspiring Monks in front of her. After the Peak's fall during the Burning Legion's third invasion, Lianji joins the Order of the Broken Temple and is seen in the Hall of the Twin Brothers of the Temple of Five Dawns on the Wandering Isle.
Wistera is a sleeping green dragon located in the Emerald Enclave in Valdrakken. Her dreams are occasionally projected out into the room.
Wixler Brass is a human located at Tradewinds Counting House in Boralus.
Woodsman Drake is a human located outside the Amberpine Lodge in the contested territory of the Grizzly Hills.
Wolf-Rider Gaja is a Mag'har orc commander of the Kor'kron found at Lion's Landing during the Lion's Landing scenario.
Wolfhandler Ang'cha is an orc stable master located at Wor'gol in Frostfire Ridge.
Woim is a blood elf vendor located at the Ruins of Lordaeron in Tirisfal Glades.
Wolf Rider Mogra is an orc located at Far Watch Post in the Northern Barrens.
Wolf Rider Zeg is a dead orc located in Razor Hill in Durotar.
Wolf Rider Gruka is a dead orc located in Razor Hill in Durotar.
Worg Master Kruush is a fel orc found in the kennel of Zeth'Gor in Hellfire Peninsula. He leads the wolf riders of the Bleeding Hollow clan.
Worgmistress Othana is an orc member of the Blackrock clan located at Black Tooth Hovel in the Burning Steppes. She is responsible for taking care of the Blackrock Worgs in the camp.
World Brewing Trainer is a night elf who taught Brewing. Her ID was eventually reused for Winwa.
Wrahk is a orc tailoring vendor located at the Crossroads in the Northern Barrens. He was present during the Legion Invasions.
Wounded Dalaran Shield Guard is a human found lying down with other wounded in First to Your Aid in the Magus Commerce Exchange within Dalaran.
Wounded Dalaran Watcher is a human found lying down with other wounded in First to Your Aid in the Magus Commerce Exchange within Dalaran.
Worn Dagger is the starting weapon for human, gnome, and night elf rogues; they also all wield a Worn Dirk.
Worn Battleaxe is the starting weapon of dwarf and orc warriors.
Worn Wood Chopper is the starting weapon for goblin, undead, human, and worgen hunters.
Worn Axe is the starting weapon for orc, troll, and worgen rogues, they also wield Worn Dirk.
Wounded Soldier is a human located in the Stair of Destiny in Hellfire Peninsula. He spawns near the Operations Officer.
Wotan was a great hunter of the Winterskorn clan. Byakko was his companion.
Worn Anvil is an anvil located in the Vault of the Wardens during the demon hunter starting experience.

Wravien was an agent of the Violet Eye who can now be found in Karazhan. He was the last of at least three agents sent to find Medivh's Journal in Karazhan (the others being Kamsis and Gradav). His spirit will spend eternity reading through the many books in Medivh's library, as he is forever trapped there.

Wray was a dwarf warrior who claimed the sword Thunderfury, Blessed Blade of the Windseeker from Thunderaan. Apparently wielding the legendary weapon for years afterward, he died in Azsuna in the Broken Isles while facing Ragemaw. He is seen during the shaman Class Hall quest Blessed Blade of the Windseeker.
Wuark is an orc armor & shield vendor located in Razor Hill in Durotar. He was present during the events of the battle at the Gates of Orgrimmar, working in the forge.

Wrynn's Raiders is a 10 man raid group formed near the entrance into the Molten Fields of Firelands within the Molten Front zone. They can be seen waiting around on the AFK member of their raid Garl Grimgrizzle while growing impatient. There is a fish feast, a mage table, and even a cauldron down nearby.
Wugou is the ancient spirit of earth on the Wandering Isle. He can be found sleeping at the Dai-Lo Farmstead.
Wyles was a human who fought against the Syndicate in Arathi Highlands. He fell and his badge was taken by his killer, kept as a trophy until its retrieval by hired adventurers.

Wyndarr Shadefist is a character that appears on the following World of Warcraft: Trading Card Game cards. *Wrathgate #128 - Wyndarr Shadefist *Class Starter 2011: Alliance Rogue #21 - Wyndarr Shadefist
Wyvern Sting is a level 75 Beast Mastery and Marksmanship hunter talent. It puts an enemy to sleep for 30 seconds.
Xor'juul was a jungle troll hunter trainer located in the Valley of Honor in Orgrimmar.
X'yera was a jungle troll priest trainer located in the Valley of Spirits in Orgrimmar.
Xandar Goodbeard is a dwarf general goods vendor located at the Farstrider Lodge in Loch Modan.
Xirkos is a pit lord and overseer of Forge Camp: Fear, in west Nagrand.
Xerash Fireblade is an orc found at Lariss Pavilion in Feralas.

Xanon is a night elf Sentinel known for his sharp eyes. He was Commander Haldrissa Woodshaper's best scout. He died in a scouting mission during which he and Commander Haldrissa discovered that the Horde have been using goblin shredders to clear more of Ashenvale's forest.

Xiao is a pandaren monk found at the Banquet Grounds of the Tian Monastery in the Jade Forest. He is Master Stone Fist's best student. The master would have graduated him several times over, but Instructor Xann insists that he needs more discipline. Stone Fist also believes that young Xiao has a great future in martial arts. After the adventurer attended the banquet, Xiao sparred with them, after which he sent them to Xann and Groundskeeper Wu. He and other students eventually graduated. He later joins with Lin Tenderpaw and adventurers and searches for the Hidden Master in the Valley of the Four Winds. He describes himself as the "oldest and fattest" of the group of young monks and appears

Xan is a void god found in , the last boss/elite you have to kill as a hunter to save and tame the spirit beast Gara. The Lord of Glass, a void god who calls himself Xan, took Mother Om'ra's soul captive in the void realm.
Xeranitas is a night elf located at Lunarfall in . He can only be recruited using the Headhunter's Harvest from Lunarfall Inn.
Xel'varek is a fel lord that appears in Tanaris during the Legion Invasions.
Xargraxach is an elite pit lord fighting the Druids of the Claw and Goldrinn at the Screaming Cliffs on the Broken Shore.
Xeth'tal is a pit lord located in the Annihilan Pits in Krokuun.
Xelendus Felwatcher is a blood elf located at Wingrest Embassy in the Waking Shores.
Xagnus Everbane is a human death knight located at the Ashvane Company Yards in Boralus.
Xingief is a human located at the Wild Coast in the Waking Shores.
Xitostrasz is a red dragon located in Flashfrost Assault in the Waking Shores.
Xalkigos was a blue dragon who was killed by Neltharion's betrayal during the War of the Ancients. His name is on a Faded Gravestone at the Veiled Ossuary.
Xuligosa was a blue dragon who was killed by Neltharion's betrayal during the War of the Ancients. Her name is on a Crumbling Gravestone at the Veiled Ossuary.

Yarlyn Amberstill is a dwarf child rabbit vendor located at Amberstill Ranch in Dun Morogh. She runs very quickly near the entrance to the ram pen as she tries to catch her pet rabbit, Fluffy. She was present during the Legion Invasions.

Yelmak is an orc artisan alchemy trainer located in the Drag in Orgrimmar. He was present at the funeral ceremony of Vol'jin in the Dranosh'ar Blockade. After it was over, he was seen standing in front of his shop. He appears dead in the Vision of Orgrimmar. Next to his body are his notes.
Yaw Sharpmane is a tauren hunter trainer located in Bloodhoof Village in Mulgore.
Yarr Hammerstone is a dwarf artisan mining trainer located in Steelgrill's Depot in Dun Morogh.
Yanni Stoutheart is a dwarf general goods vendor located in Stoutlager Inn in Thelsamar in Loch Modan.
Yarley is a dwarf vendor located inside the Caverns of Time in Tanaris.

Yelnagi Blackarm is an orc located in Razor Hill in Durotar. During the events of Escalation, he was cornered inside the Razor Hill inn. As the Darkspear Rebellion fought the Kor'krons, he asked that the people not be hurt and said that the revolutionaries were welcome to quarter in the area. Upon Augur Narali's death, he remarked that she deserved worse. During the Fourth War, he was encountered by Alliance champions when they set fire to town's storehouses.
Yol'Tithian was a Highborne sorcerer who assisted Dath'Remar Sunstrider in the escape from Zin-Azshari.

Yorg Stormheart is a dwarf and the king of the Frostborn. He has agreed to allow his people to join the Alliance and has also befriended the Explorers' League. He holds great respect amongst his people as well as his fellow Alliance members. He is glad to help the Alliance and his dwarven brethren in any way he can, although he seems to be a little troubled with allowing his people into others' affairs that might cost their lives. Yorg resides in Frosthold in the Storm Peaks, but leaves as soon as a player finishes the quest line, where he is involved, and he is actually revealed to be Muradin Bronzebeard, who was long-thought to have been killed by Arthas. Velog Icebellow takes Yorg's place
Yolanda Haymer is a level 70 human reagent vendor located at the Amberpine Lodge in the Grizzly Hills.
Ymirjar Lord's Plate is the lower-level tier 10 tank warrior set.
Ymirjar Lord's Plate is the lower-level tier 10 damage warrior set.

Yernim Weltom was a human servant of the Trollbane family of Arathi Highlands. He had the task of tending the Trollbane family's rarer artifacts — back when they were merely kept in a locked room and not in the crypt. When the family manor was hit with a surprise bandit raid while much of the house guard was out fighting the Horde, Yernim hid the artifacts in the kitchen, filling the priceless chalice of opal voices with gravy, tossing the ancient sword Trol'kalar into the pile of pig offal and putting the cloak of elemental protection on himself and jumping into the massive kitchen fire to hide. Prince Liam, grandfather of Galen Trollbane, was so impressed with his servant's ingenuity that

Yancey Grillsen is a Bloodsail human found just north of Booty Bay in the Cape of Stranglethorn. He is unknowingly deceived by adventurers loyal to Booty Bay and lets them spy into the Bloodsails. During the Burning Legion's third invasion of Azeroth, Yancey was recruited by the Uncrowned and relocated for the Hall of Shadows where he recruited Crew of Pirates for the Shadowblade.

Yeniss is a jungle troll warrior trainer located at Sen'jin Village in Durotar. He is in the ground floor of the largest hut, either standing in the eastern alcove or chatting with Trayexir the weapon merchant. He wields a Mok'Nathal Warblade.

Ya Firebough was the mayor of Firebough Nook; he was one of the few villagers to survive to the attack of the sha-possessed yaungol, along with Sya Zhong, Old Lady Fung and Jin Warmkeg. All of them were rescued and led them to safety to Shado-Pan Fallback by an adventurer.
Yano Barkhoof is the Horde druid leader of Ashran, found in Warspear Outpost. Yano is located on the right-hand side just inside the entrance to the base and can be found talking to Alascene.
Y'rogg is an orc located in the Frostwall's Scribe's Quarters. He accepts Cerulean Pigments work orders creating War Paints.
Yardley is a makrura character in Smokywood Pastures Presents: A Winter Veil Carol.
Yasmina Nerossa is a human located in Greyfang Enclave in Dalaran.
Yorick was a human who fought against the Syndicate in Arathi Highlands. He fell and his badge was taken by his killer, kept as a trophy until its retrieval by hired adventurers.
Yonzi was the leader of the Skalaxi arakkoa, a remnant of the fallen Apexis civilization, around 1,000 years before the opening of the Dark Portal.
Yolstrasza was a red dragon located with Jaelie at the Serene Dreams Spa in Thaldraszus. She was replaced by Yolvana.
Yolvana is a night elf found with Jaelora at the Serene Dreams Spa in Thaldraszus.
Yigrigosa was a blue dragon who was killed in the Crystalsong forest disaster. Her name is on a Fresh Gravestone at the Veiled Ossuary.
Yazdan is a man'ari eredar located in Fiend's Run in the Antoran Wastes. He is an ally of Arzaal and provides an Argunite Cluster when spoken to.

Ysida Harmon was a human found in Stratholme. Ysida was Anthion Harmon's wife. Baron Rivendare was holding Ysida captive, and she had to be saved by engaging him in battle within 45 minutes of entering the instance's second gate. Her rescue was part of the Dungeon Set 2 quests. She has been missing since the Cataclysm and has presumably either been saved or killed. In either case, her ghostly husband can still be seen outside the gates of Stratholme.
Ysuria is a high elf portal trainer located at the base of Jaina's Tower on Theramore Isle in Dustwallow Marsh. It's unknown if she survived the Attack on Theramore Isle.
Yuriv was a human paladin that left in a crusade to kill the Scourge, leaving behind his wife and children. He was slain and buried in a grave at the Sepulcher of Silverpine Forest.
Yumanis Oakengrip is a night elf located at the Lunarfall in . He can only be recruited using the Headhunter's Harvest from Lunarfall Inn.
Yvette Blackheart is a human located at the Lunarfall in . She can only be recruited using the Headhunter's Harvest from Lunarfall Inn.
Yu'un Tigersbite is an orc Brewmaster monk. Her Alliance counterpart is Mina Kunis.
Yu'lon's Gift is a Mistweaver and Windwalker monk PvP talent.
Yrdris Lightblade is a night elf located at Felwing Ledge on Mardum.

Yukha is an orc shaman of the Earthen Ring, and a trusted friend of Thrall. He personally came to Orgrimmar to inform Thrall that something was terribly wrong in the spirit world, noting that he had never seen the spirits act as they've done. In light of both the Earthen Ring shaman and the Cenarion Circle druids sensing the disturbance, Yukha agreed to serve as Thrall's messenger to the night elves, who had relocated to Nordrassil. Though Tyrande's rage had not lessened, she did agree on the meeting with the condition that Yukha inform Thrall that he "must bring what is owed." A declaration that confused both orcs. When Thrall mentioned his intention to bring Baine Bloodhoof and Calia Menet
Yvendormi is a bronze dragon located at the Ruby Life Pools in the Waking Shores.

Zaldimar Wefhellt is a human mage trainer located in the Lion's Pride Inn in Goldshire, in Elwynn Forest. He is located in the upstairs section of the inn, in the left-most room from going up the stairs. During the War Against the Nightmare, he and the rest of the town of Goldshire have had their minds trapped in the Emerald Nightmare. In Marshal Dughan's nightmare, Zaldimar accompanied Dughan on a mission in Jasperlode Mine and betrayed him after revealing he was a necromancer.
Zanara is an orc bow vendor located in Brackenwall Village in Dustwallow Marsh.

Zaladormu is a large, translucent bronze dragon resting on the dais below the Hourglass of Time in the center of the Caverns of Time. During the Children's Week quest Time to Visit the Caverns, players can take the orphans Dornaa and Salandria to visit the Caverns. Upon approaching the Hourglass of Time, nearby Wardens of Time move to attack the orphan until Zaladormu suddenly stirs and commands the Wardens to stop, saying: "This girl has done nothing, and will not be held accountable for what she might do, or fail to do, in the future." He then tells Dornaa/Salandria to go in peace before going back to rest.
Zalna Wefhellt is a human mage trainer located at Sentinel Hill in Westfall.

Zabrax is a jungle troll monk trainer located in the Darkspear Training Grounds of the Darkspear Isle on the Echo Isles in Durotar. He is currently the only non-pandaren monk trainer, and can be seen sparing with Tsu the Wanderer, who presumably taught him the ways of the monk. When Zalazane returned, he defended the area.
Zakk Sinon is a blue dragon located at Beryl Egress in Winterspring.
Za'kaar is a fel lord that appears at the Legion Invasion locations.
Zan'do was an outcast troll witch doctor who was manipulated by :Xal'atath, Blade of the Black Empire into awakening Kith'ix prior to the Aqir and Troll War.
Zanda Frostsong is an orc located in Anglepoint Wharf in Tiragarde Sound during the Alliance War Campaign.
Zan'chi is a jungle troll mage found in the Pathfinder's Den of Orgrimmar.
Zaggrel Darktooth was an orc located in the Umbral Halls in Tanaan Jungle during the Assault on the Dark Portal.
Zayus was a jungle troll priest trainer located in the Valley of Spirits in Orgrimmar.
Zargh is an orc meat vendor located at the Crossroads in the Northern Barrens. He sells Recipe: Hot Lion Chops. He was present during the Legion Invasions.
Zannok Hidepiercer is a night elf leatherworking vendor located at Valor's Rest in Silithus.

Zazzo Twinklefingers is a gnomish arcane mage in the employ of Ravenholdt and Wrathion. He appears at various locations during the Fangs of the Father questline. He later appears in the Valley of the Four Winds, investigating the waters from the Vale of Eternal Blossoms with a Blacktalon Agent, walking around the Pools of Purity. Zazzo says that there is some kind of residual energy in the waters, similar to an energy pattern from Sholazar Basin.
Zaren Hoffle is a human engineer in the Engineering Works in Lunarfall.

Zarka is an orc warrior of the Frostwolf clan and chosen companion of the wolf Drift. When Durotan led a party north to aid the spirits, both Zarka and Drift were a part of it. Drift would be ultimately killed by members of the Red Walker clan. However as a gift from the spirits Drek'Thar would be allowed to resurrect Drift. Zarka would then ride Drift in battle against the Red Walker and assist in the destruction of the barbaric clan. After traveling through the to Azeroth, Kagra was present during the Frostwolves' meeting with the humans of Stormwind. She laughed at the large numbers in which the humans arrived, and expressed her dislike of the situation, but ultimately honored Durotan's l
Zar'teth is a fel lord that appeared in Tarren Mill during Legion Invasions. He is also present in Val'sharah during Legion Assaults.
Zayn Starseer was a blood elf located at Wingrest Embassy in the Waking Shores. He was replaced by Zayn Starmaker.
Zel'mak was a jungle troll warrior trainer located in the Hall of the Brave in the Valley of Honor in Orgrimmar.
Zevrost is an orc warlock trainer located in the Cleft of Shadow in Orgrimmar.
Zezzak is an orc found in Spinebreaker Post in the Hellfire Peninsula.
Zelfrax is a demon resembling a gargoyle that has taken over Witch Hill in Dustwallow Marsh, has risen the dead, and is driving mad. Its death is the objective of Cleansing Witch Hill.
Zedd is a deceased dwarf located in Wyrmskull Village in Howling Fjord.

Zhu Longbrow was a famous pandaren hunter who founded the Zhu Province and Zhu's Watch. Prior to his arrival, the area now called the Zhu Province was an untamed land still considered part of the Krasarang Wilds. The journey through the area was perilous, and many pandaren lost their lives to the great beasts of the forest while attempting to reach the coast. Tired of the needless loss of life, Zhu, along with his wife Rin and their son Po - both formidable hunters in their own right - carved out and settled a corner of the wilds. Zhu did not want to settle the wilds entirely, though many begged him to do so. In his wisdom, he understood that they, too, served a purpose: protecting the great
Zen Focus was a Mistweaver monk honor talent, available at rank 34.
Zen Moment was a Windwalker monk honor talent, available at rank 40.

Zeros is a blue dragon first encountered as a blue whelp held captive by Normantis the Deposed in the Lair of the Deposed in Azsuna. When Normantis was killed, Zeros flew out of the cave and disappeared. Years later, he was found in Booty Bay where he took on a more mature visage form to do business. He ended up in serious financial trouble, owing money to Baron Revilgaz. Being a dragon, he could've ended this quickly but he sought to solve his problems with gold rather than violence, and was helped by Senegos and an adventurer.
Zepharion is a black dragon located at the Obsidian Throne and Flayscale Camp in the Waking Shores.
Zelagosa is a blue dragon located in the Sapphire Enclave in Valdrakken. She lives with Sabigosa, Hildegosa, and their cat Peabody.

Zmodlor is a minor demon who specializes in infiltration. During the events in Cycle of Hatred, he recruits citizens of Orgrimmar and Theramore into the Burning Blade and uses them to raise tensions between the orcs and humans. He was banished thanks to the combined efforts of Aegwynn and Jaina Proudmoore.
Zlagk is an orc meat and drink vendor located in the Valley of Trials in Durotar. Zlagk appears at Frostwall if the Barn is built to level 2.

Zoblam is a male orc ghoul of the Scourge. The creature is generally humanoid, with a hunched posture and a leering face. Mad eyes glare from its pallid skin and its lips part hungrily to reveal yellowed teeth flecked with gore. He is a fighter. He speaks Orcish.
Zoklaw Irtak is an orc blacksmith vendor located at Crushblow in the Twilight Highlands.

Zorix was a golden proto-dragon who knew Malygos, Neltharion, Ysera, and Alexstrasza in the ancient past before becoming a victim of Galakrond. His mate Talonixa led the intelligent proto-dragons against Galakrond and the undead.

Zoradan was a Wildhammer dwarf during the Second War. He was impressed by how Turalyon could use a hammer like a dwarf and saw him in action when the Horde first attacked the Hinterlands. His status remains unknown.

Zukaza is an orc located in Exile's Rise in . For the longest time, he was in love with Kat'la. After going stargazing together in their youths, Zukaza held deep feelings for her. Despite her having already found a mate, Zukaza never gave up on her. His last failed attempt at winning her over was giving her the flowers known as Lunarblossom. This ended in failure when one of his boars ate the flowers.
Zoggosh is an orc located onboard the Blackhand's Might in the Iron Docks. He is Koramar's first mate.
Zugunk Poisonfiend is an orc located in the Temple of Karabor in .
Zienestrasz is a red dragon located at the Ruby Lifeshrine in the Waking Shores.
Zira is a human located in Valdrakken. On her hand is Subject Eleven.
Zolthros Runegazer is a blood elf located Emberwatch in the Ohn'ahran Plains. He summons Enchanted Brooms, Enchanted Picks, Enchanted Brushes, and Enchanted Sieve.
Zoristrasz is a red dragon in a blood elf visage found sitting under a tree in the Ruby Lifeshrine in the Waking Shores.
Zurai is a jungle troll general goods vendor located at Swamprat Post in Zangarmarsh.

Zul'ajik was a jungle troll witch doctor. Gimbolt Surehammer, Maer-thiss and Ziggler sought him out in order to hire him to perform a ritual to contact spirits which would lead to the Demonwell. Because of Zul'ajik's hatred for goblins, Ziggler chose to stay outside of the camp and tinker on his clockwork dwarf. While under the influence of blue mushrooms, Ziggler interrupted the ritual when he piloted the clockwork dwarf through the camp and trampled both the troll's tent and Maer-thiss. Gimbolt decided to flee with Ziggler, while Maer-thiss and Zul'ajik decided to kill them both.

Zul'iste is a jungle troll witch doctor. He crafted the first spear of hungry ghosts shortly after the Darkspear tribe joined with Thrall. Zul'iste designed the weapon to attract malicious spirits to the Horde's enemies.
Zumolo is a priest trainer at the Crossroads in the Northern Barrens. He defended the town during the Legion Invasions.
Zuuzuu was a troll member of the Twilight's Hammer cult. When Kirygosa was held captive in the Wyrmrest Temple, she and Josah were to transport her to Chromatus. Kiry killed her and escaped.
Zulathra was a great high priest of the Zandalar tribe. He was responsible for the alliance between the Zandalari trolls and the mogu empire, but died during Lei Shen's attempted conquest of Uldum.
Zungal is an orc. He is the son of Kerzug and has a daughter named .
Zyrus Hallewell is a human located in Arom's Stand in Drustvar. He is also present during Faction Assault on Drustvar.

Zun is an orc child who was travelling with his mother Gowzis, a Forsaken apothecary Cotley, and a band of Horde refugees across the Arathi Highlands. After the Fourth War, the refugees were approached Visrynn, a dark ranger, who joined them on the condition that they take a vow of silence. While she traveled with them for half a day, Cotley tended to her injured hand and learned that she sought to go south and chart a boat from Faldir's Cove. In time, an Alliance strike team led by Turalyon and Alleria Windrunner came upon them looking for Visrynn. Zun, in panic, tried to attack them only to be humorously subdued by Turalyon. In fear for her son's life, Gowzis begged them to spare her son,
Zyaana is a man'ari eredar located in the Arinor Gardens in the Eredath. She is an ally of Arzaal and provides an Argunite Cluster when spoken to.
Abyssal Doomhound's Pursuit is the tier 36 demon hunter set.

Adalar is a member of the Stormriders. He was first encountered in Dornogal where he could be found relaxing in the Keepers Terrace. Later he showed up in Dhar Oztan, feeling a compulsion to come to the place. After Lufsela managed to summon new stormrooks at the peak of Dhar Oztan, Adalar ended up bonding with one of them, which he named Phawa. He then joined the Stormriders and was trained in aerial maneuvers by Kurdran Wildhammer. Soon after he took part in the battle against the Colossal Titan Construct that activated when the earthen of Khaz Algar renounced the Edicts. After that he can be encountered back in Dhar Oztan, now the home of the Stormriders once again, sleeping in a stormroo

Aeonara Dawnshade is a void elf located on Telogrus Rift. When the Shadowguard attacked the Rift, she helped defend the camp. Aeonara accompanied Alleria Windrunner and her fellow void elves to K'aresh to aid in the battle against Dimensius. She can be found in Shadow Point outside of Manaforge Omega. Aeonara was among the forces of the Vanguard of the Light fighting against the Devouring Host in Parhelion Plaza on the Isle of Quel'Danas.
Aeriah Sunfire is a high elf author. He wrote volumes 3 to 5 of troll histories.
Aelric Leid is the founder and leader of the Order of Night, a cult of the Hallowfall Arathi that serves the Void and has allied with Xal'atath. He is the main antagonist of the Hallowfall storyline.
Aether Fragment is an Arcane mage talent. It is an exclusive choice node with Leysight.
Aegwynn's Technique is an Arcane mage talent. It is an exclusive choice node with Arcane Echo.
Afadra Dunwall is a dwarf located in Old Ironforge in Ironforge.

Agent Keanna is a human found at Ariden's Camp in . An agent of the Violet Eye, she eventually managed to infiltrate Karazhan where she stayed in the guest chambers and kept an encoded log of her observations. Her death was confirmed by the Violet Eye shortly before the tower was shut down. The last few entries in her log describe a demon of the Burning Legion arriving at the top of the tower.
Aggravate Wounds is a Druid of the Claw hero talent for druids.
Agent Brown is a human located at the Seat of Knowledge during the Mind-Seeker secret. He can be found next to Agent Black and Lyssara Duskmourne.
Agent Black is a human located at the Seat of Knowledge during the Mind-Seeker secret. He can be found next to Agent Brown and Lyssara Duskmourne.

Aiva is a faerie dragon located near Threshrak in the Emerald Gardens in the Ohn'ahran Plains.
Ahnzon is a proto-dragon located in Galakrond's Fall in the Dawn of the Infinite as part of the Blight of Galakrond encounter.

Ailsa Bronzebeard is a dwarf and ancestor of the three Bronzebeard brothers, Magni, Muradin, and Brann. Her name is inscribed in Mina Stormsmith's runes in :Mithrios, Bronzebeard's Legacy. She was married to Mina and brought her to the Bronzebeard clan. They also had children.
Airborne Rhythm is a Windwalker monk talent. It is an exclusive choice node with Hurricane's Vault.
Aldrachi Tactics is an Aldrachi Reaver hero talent for demon hunters.
Alara Grovemender is a night elf druid located in during Nightmare Incursions.
Al'kubian is a nerubian sage located in the Salien Gutters in Azj-Kahet.
Al'raza is a blood elf located on the coast of Sunstrider Isle in Eversong Woods.

Alfie Turner is a human druid found in the Eye of Ysera in the Emerald Dream. Although they didn't know each other for long, he was taught by Gracus. He was called by the adventurer to come to say farewell to the dying Gracus and attended his passing. He appears to have taken over the care of Gracus' ducks.
Alfwhit Grigdert is a human found in the secret room of the Karazhan Crypts. Warlocks can send him to the jail area, where he will summon Unk'omon.
Alfina Nightgaze is a night elf located in the Sky Enclave in Dalaran in the .
Alysara Shineruby is a blood elf located at a southeastern lake in Northern Stranglethorn during Love is in the Air alongside Bo'danda and Jimothy Lewis.
Alyssian Windcaller is a night elf druid located in during Nightmare Incursions.
Altheris is a blood elf located at Thuron's Livery at Eversong Woods.

Amir'relo is a faerie dragon seemingly one of the two that was found Kery'nael Thorngale in the Emerald Dream, the other being :Kal'andu. Amir'relo was later seen at the gathering in Amirdrassil, accompanying Kery'nael. It continued to follow him after Bel'ameth was established.
Amokarok is a worgen leader located in the Rotting Orchard in during Nightmare Incursions.
Amplification Core is a Totemic hero talent for shaman. It is an exclusive choice node with Oversurge.
Anakron is a human first spotted at certain Infinite Bazaars in Pandaria Remix. In most of his appearances, he is simply called Hooded Supplier. He first revealed his name in phase 2 of Legion Remix.
Ancient Fellowship is a Farseer hero talent for shaman. It is an exclusive choice node with Latent Wisdom.

Andee Seabraid is a dwarf located in the Forgegrounds in Dornogal. She also arrives at Dunelle's Kindness in Hallowfall, representing the Trading Post in the trade alliance between the Hallowfall Arathi and the Council of Dornogal.
Ancient Saltsnap Turtle is a dragon turtle that was planned to appear as part of a vignette. It would likely have been accompanied by Saltsnap Turtles and Saltsnap Yearlings.
Angus Flagonshot is a dwarf located in the Steam Pools in Feralas during Love is in the Air.
Animated Vault Protector is a mechanical dragon located in Obsidian Citadel in the Waking Shores.
Annihilan's Bellow is a Diabolist warlock hero talent. It is an exclusive choice node with Soul-Etched Circles.
Annele May is a blood elf located at the Solaarian Sunbath in Eversong Woods.
Apostle Fenarelle is a night elf located at the Fields of reverie in the Emerald Dream.
Apocalypse Now is a Rider of the Apocalypse hero talent for death knights.
Apprentice Crafter is a blood elf vendor located at the Artisan's Market in Valdrakken.
Apprentice Theranil is a blood elf located at Thuron's Livery at Eversong Woods.
Apprentice Diell is a blood elf located at Saltheril's Haven in Eversong Woods. He is the renown quartermaster for the Magisters faction, offering rewards in exchange for Brimming Arcana.
Archdruid Bhogo is a night elf druid found in a barrow den in Amirdrassil. He is accompanied by his pet frostsaber named Daphne.
Archaeologist Koranir is a blood elf located in Cascades Canyon in the Ohn'ahran Plains.
